pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/21249

Replaces https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/21252

Our functional tests spin up a server per test. Since tests can run in parallel, it was possible for 2 tests to start at the same time, and during the server startup DataProtection will either find a key or create one and write it to file. This could cause issues with one of the servers writing the file while the other tries to read it resulting in a failure.
pr_comments: Nice! This one saves me some build ops work 😄
